title: Velikovsky's When Worlds Collide: the asteroid belt as a destroyed planet

tellings.quote: When Worlds Collide is an old classic uh piece that Velikovski wrote. It's the theory that the asteroid belt

plain: The asteroid belt, the ring of rocks between Mars and Jupiter, is said to be the wreckage of a planet that was destroyed. The lawyer Dan Sheehan brings up this idea on the show, crediting it to "an old classic" he calls When Worlds Collide and says the writer Immanuel Velikovsky wrote. If true, the solar system would have gone through a catastrophe that once broke up a whole world.
